summary: The food looks great, but ordering takes too much effort. Fix the hidden Order button, the small menu text and the surprise delivery fee first.

steps.line: Hi Mani, I'm {me}. I'll try to order one medium pizza on this website, the way a real customer would. Let's see how it goes.
steps.fix: Watch his face. Each reaction points to one problem.

steps.line: Oh, that's very loud. Bright red background with yellow text. My eyes don't know where to look. The headline and the offer are fighting each other.
steps.fix: Use one strong colour for the main button only. Put text on a calm background with at least 4.5 to 1 contrast.

steps.line: Hmm, I have to lean in to read this. The pizza descriptions look like twelve pixels, in light grey. On a phone this will be very hard to read.
steps.fix: Body text at least 16 px. Use dark grey, not light grey, for descriptions.

steps.line: Wait, where do I actually order? I scrolled twice. The Order now button is outlined and the same colour as everything else. I almost missed it.
steps.fix: Make Order now a filled button with the brand colour. Keep it visible in the header while scrolling.

steps.line: Oh no. I picked my toppings, then changed the size to medium, and all my toppings are gone. That is really frustrating. Real customers will leave here.
steps.fix: Keep the selected toppings when the size changes. Show the price update right next to the size.

steps.line: What? A delivery fee of forty nine rupees appears only on the last step. I didn't see this anywhere before. This feels like a trick.
steps.fix: Show the delivery fee in the cart, before checkout. No surprises on the last step.

steps.line: Now this part is nice. The tracking page is clean, the steps are clear and the time is big and easy to read. Good job here.
steps.fix: Keep this. Use the same calm style on the menu pages.

steps.line: So overall, the food looks tasty, but ordering takes too much effort. Fix the order button, the text size and the hidden fee first. Those three will help the most.
steps.fix: Top 3: visible Order button, 16 px text, show fees early.
